steps.instruction: Find and tap the WhatsApp app
steps.visualDescription: green icon with white phone in a speech bubble
steps.fallbackHint: if not on home screen, swipe up to open app drawer and search WhatsApp

steps.instruction: Tap the green new chat button
steps.visualDescription: round green button with a white chat or message plus icon
steps.fallbackHint: if not visible, tap the Chats tab at the bottom first

steps.instruction: Tap the name of the person
steps.visualDescription: a row showing a contact photo and name
steps.fallbackHint: scroll down to find the person you want

steps.instruction: Tap the message box and type
steps.visualDescription: white rounded text box at the bottom that says Message
steps.fallbackHint: if keyboard does not appear, tap the message box again

steps.visualDescription: round green button with a white paper plane arrow
steps.fallbackHint: if there is no send button, make sure you have typed a message

steps.instruction: Find and tap the YouTube app
steps.visualDescription: red square icon with a white play triangle
steps.fallbackHint: if not on home screen, swipe up to open app drawer and search YouTube

steps.instruction: Tap the search icon at the top
steps.visualDescription: magnifying glass icon in the top bar
steps.fallbackHint: the search icon is in the top right corner

steps.instruction: Type what you want to watch
steps.visualDescription: text box at the top that says Search YouTube
steps.fallbackHint: if keyboard does not appear, tap the search box again

steps.instruction: Tap the first video to play
steps.visualDescription: a large video thumbnail picture in the results
steps.fallbackHint: scroll down to see more videos

guides.task: take a photo with the camera

steps.instruction: Find and tap the Camera app
steps.fallbackHint: if not on home screen, swipe up to open app drawer and search Camera

steps.visualDescription: large round white button at the bottom center
steps.fallbackHint: the shutter button is the big round button at the bottom

steps.instruction: Find and tap the Settings app
steps.visualDescription: grey gear or cog wheel icon
steps.fallbackHint: if not on home screen, swipe up to open app drawer and search Settings

steps.visualDescription: a row near the top that says Network and internet
steps.fallbackHint: scroll down if you do not see it

steps.instruction: Tap the Wi-Fi switch to turn it on
steps.visualDescription: a switch next to the Wi-Fi label
steps.fallbackHint: tap the Wi-Fi row first if there is no switch

steps.instruction: Find and tap the Gmail app
steps.visualDescription: white icon with a red and white M envelope
steps.fallbackHint: if not on home screen, swipe up to open app drawer and search Gmail

steps.visualDescription: colorful button with a pencil that says Compose
steps.fallbackHint: the compose button is in the bottom right corner

steps.instruction: Type the email address in To
steps.visualDescription: text box at the top labelled To
steps.fallbackHint: tap the To box to start typing

steps.instruction: Tap the send arrow at the top
steps.visualDescription: paper plane arrow icon in the top bar
steps.fallbackHint: make sure you have typed a recipient and message first
